not_covered.reason: Bare `psmux` on 3.3.8 starts or attaches to a session in the DEFAULT namespace. MUST DO 11 forbids touching a session this lane does not own, and MUST DO 2 forbids sharing a namespace, so the only safe way to run it is inside a throwaway namespace where it would create state that then needs teardown. It is therefore recorded as not covered rather than run against shared state. It is also not in the 19-invocation census.
